title: How to Ride China's High-Speed Trains in 2026 (Tourist Guide) | China Travel Expert
description:
China has the world's largest high-speed rail network — over 50,000 km linking 50+ cities at up to 350 km/h. Here's everything a first-time visitor needs to book, board, and ride China's bullet trains in 2026, counted down from 9 to 1 — with real prices and the one thing to set up before you fly.

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:39 Why the train, not the plane
1:07 9. Book with just your passport (12306 & Trip.com)
1:52 8. G vs D vs C: which train to pick
2:22 7. Get there early + the passport gate
2:55 6. Luggage rules (no checked bags)
3:30 5. Pick the right seat (A/F/C/D, skip B)
3:59 Which city are you flying into?
4:18 4. Food on board
4:55 3. Seat class & the price math ($76 vs $242)
5:39 2. Refunds & changes
6:18 1. It replaces domestic flights
6:52 Bonus: set this up before you fly
7:21 Next up

🧭 Expert Tip: Register your passport on the 12306 app (or set up Trip.com) BEFORE you fly — approval can take up to two business days, so clear it while you're still home, then screenshot your car and seat number for every leg.
